templates.name: Bible Study
templates.tagline: Ivory paper, gold linework and teal scripture pills; an illuminated-manuscript teaching deck with click-to-read verse popups.
templates.density: low on the slide, high behind the click

palette.description: ivory paper with soft radial glows; gold for titles and ornaments, teal for structure and scripture references, copper/peach number badges, crimson only for warning wording

typography.style: one classical serif for everything; centred titles between fading gold rules; verses at 23–32px on the slide and 48px in the popup

templates.best_for: Leading a group through key passages and questions: Bible studies, sermon outlines, Sunday-school and small-group lessons, any teaching talk where the slide shows the structure and the full text opens on click. Built for Chinese (Simplified) content; works for English with the same serif.
templates.avoid_for: Data-heavy business decks, dark-room keynotes, or anything that needs charts and dense numbers.

templates.name: BytePlus
templates.tagline: Navy-and-gold deck with the BytePlus wordmark, product timeline and a media-first runtime for image and video proof slides.
templates.density: medium: one claim per slide, proof in images and videos

palette.description: all-dark deep-navy slides with a blue glow top-right (the BytePlus wordmark is white), warm off-white text, one antique-gold accent; the only other colour comes from the logo, product logos and the customer's media

typography.cn: Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC
typography.style: serif headlines with a gold-italic second half, sans body, uppercase mono chrome; sizes in calc(N * var(--u)) with --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh)

templates.best_for: BytePlus solution and product decks that prove claims with real outputs: image before/after pairs, vertical ad videos, demo recordings, plus the standard About-BytePlus timeline.
templates.avoid_for: Light-background or printed handouts (no light logo variant packaged), long-form reading, Bible/teaching decks.

templates.name: BytePlus Light
templates.tagline: The BytePlus deck in the light look of the official BytePlus PowerPoint master: pale blue gradient backgrounds, the dark wordmark, BytePlus blue accents and the same media-first runtime.
occasion: converting a BytePlus pptx while keeping its look
architecture and solution walkthrough with diagrams
customer / partner briefing in a bright room or on a projector
decks that will also be printed or exported to PDF
templates.density: medium: one claim per slide, proof in diagrams, images and videos

palette.bg_images: assets/img/bg-light-cover.jpg (circles + M icon: cover, part, end) and bg-light-content.jpg (white-to-blue gradient: every other slide), from the BytePlus pptx master
palette.description: light slides like the BytePlus pptx master; near-black text, one BytePlus-blue accent, white cards and plates with a soft blue shadow

typography.style: bold sans headlines with the second half in BytePlus blue (no italics), sans body, uppercase mono chrome; sizes in calc(N * var(--u)) with --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh)

templates.best_for: BytePlus decks that should match the official light PowerPoint look: pptx conversions, architecture diagrams framed on white plates, product pitches with image and video proof, the About-BytePlus timeline.
templates.avoid_for: Dark-room keynote moods (use byteplus), non-BytePlus brands, Bible/teaching decks.

templates.name: Studio
templates.tagline: Black canvas with electric-yellow type; high-voltage design studio aesthetic.

palette.description: near-black canvas with one signature electric-yellow that doubles as foreground type AND accent; reverses to yellow-paper mode for breathing room

typography.style: broadcast-grotesk display + technical mono captions; ultra-high-contrast typographic system

templates.best_for: Anything that should feel electric and design-led: studio credentials, creative agency pitches, brand showcases, art-direction reviews, fashion / sneaker brand work. Also a striking unexpected choice for tech, research, or business decks where the speaker wants the deck to *be* a brand statement.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that should feel quiet or institutional — the black-and-electric-yellow palette is the loudest in the library.

templates.name: Work Review
templates.tagline: Executive navy-and-gold review deck for project progress or work performance: results against goals, row-aligned workstreams, initiatives, reflections and next steps, with detail one click away.
templates.density: medium on the slide (headline, labelled fields, numbers); detail in popups

palette.description: all-dark navy with a faint 80px grid, warm off-white text and one antique-gold accent; light diagrams sit on white plates; solid gold marks the single top priority

typography.cn: Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC
typography.style: 48px serif slide titles with a gold underline and gold-italic second half, 30px panel titles, mono uppercase kickers; nothing below 18px at 1600x900

templates.best_for: Any review that reports results against goals and backs them with workstreams, initiatives and a plan: project progress, quarterly business or team reviews, individual performance reviews.
templates.avoid_for: Media-heavy product pitches (use byteplus) and warm teaching decks (use bible-study).
